chunks: And the earth and the mountains were carried [up], then they were crushed with a single blow.

key_terms.دَكَّةً: A single crushing blow or strike

ai.seo_question: What happens to the earth and mountains on the Day of Judgment according to Surah Al-Haqqa?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Al-Haqqa highlights the suddenness and totality of the cosmic transformation, where the earth and mountains are not merely moved but crushed into a single, uniform dust, signifying the end of the material order. This 'single strike' (dakkatan wahidah) underscores God's absolute sovereignty and the fragility of worldly structures, a theme often linked to the concept of *Ba'th* (resurrection) in Imam Ali's sermons in Nahj al-Balagha. It serves as a reminder that just as the physical world is easily dismantled, so too will human deeds be weighed with precision.
